header: THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR
Date of hearing Order with signature of Judge
body: 1. For orders on office objections at Flag-A 2. For hearing of CMA No.2284/2026 (S/A)
3. For hearing of main case 03.11.2026 Mr. Ashfaque Ali Shah, Advocate, holding brief for Syed Zaffar Ali Shah Bukhari, Advocate for petitioner.
Syed Naveed Ahmed Shah, Deputy Attorney General along with Yaseen Bhatti, Superintendent, MST “H” Division, Pakistan Post, Sukkur.

.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.- In the first round, brief was held for Mr. Zaffar Ali Shah, Advocate for petitioner, stating that he was busy before the Bench of this Court. The matter was, therefore, kept aside. On this second call, it is reported that Mr. Zaffar Ali Shah, Advocate, has proceeded to Circuit Court, Larkana. It seems that learned counsel for the petitioner is avoiding to proceed with this case. In these circumstances, we are not inclined to adjourn the matter.

The petitioner prays for suspending his order of removal from service while his appeal is pending before the Federal Service Tribunal (FST). The second prayer is for a direction to the FST to decide the appeal expeditiously. In other words, the petitioner is admittedly a civil servant who has availed remedy of appeal before the FST. The record then reflects that the petitioner had withdrawn his appeal from the FST. The petitioner, who is present, affirms that fact. Once the petitioner has withdrawn his appeal from the FST, he cannot be entertained in writ jurisdiction in view of the bar contained under Article 212 of the Constitution. The petition is thus dismissed.
J U D G E J U D G E Abdul Basit
